items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1993-05-28
items.q: the Vincent Matassi had been here before. How much before my father, I don't know.

ctx.x: Yeah, by the time he came. Yeah. The real surge was in the 1880s and 1890s, which is what I assumed when your people came.

Yeah. That's what I assumed. Well, the other ones had been here before. You know, like I said, the Vincent Matassi had been here before. How much before my father, I don't know. But obviously, he was here... What did you find one in 1908? Yeah. Yeah, and he'd been here before. Yeah.
